solutions.title: Recompute heights
solutions.strategy: For every node, compute subtree heights with an explicit stack, then check all nodes iteratively.

timeComplexity.explanation: On a skewed tree, each ancestor recomputes most descendant heights.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The explicit traversal and height stacks can store many nodes in the worst case.

solutions.title: Bottom-up height sentinel
solutions.strategy: Use iterative postorder traversal to compute each subtree height once and stop when a node is imbalanced.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every node computes its height once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The explicit stack and height table can store the tree nodes.
